title: central-monitoring-collector configure-module input
description: Configures the lightweight Grafana Alloy NS8 collector module: Hub HTTPS URL, bearer token, customer/site labels, local NS8 collection, optional unprivileged Syslog listener, and WAL disk buffer.

hub_url.description: HTTPS base URL of central-monitoring-hub (e.g. https://monitoring.msp.example.com).

auth_token.description: Tenant or collector bearer token. Required on first setup; may be empty when auth_token_unchanged is true.

collect_local_ns8.description: Collect local NS8 host metrics, Restic backup metrics, container status, and systemd journal logs.

enable_syslog_receiver.description: Expose an unprivileged UDP/TCP RFC5424/RFC3164 Syslog listener for LAN firewalls, switches, NAS, and UPS appliances.

wal_max_disk_mb.description: Maximum local Write-Ahead-Log disk cap in MiB for offline buffering during WAN outages.

tls_skip_verify.description: Allow self-signed TLS certificates on Hub URL (for staging/lab environments only).
